heading: 1 Sensor input
text: The software shall accept track reports from the primary sensor at a rate of up to 10 reports per second per target.

heading: 1 Sensor input
text: The software shall accept track reports from the secondary sensor.

heading: 2 Track lifecycle
text: The software shall create a new track within 1 s of receiving the first report of an unknown target.

heading: 2 Track lifecycle
text: The software shall delete a track within 2 s when no report has been received for that track for 10 s.

heading: 2 Track lifecycle
text: The software shall update the position of a track within 1 s of receiving a new report for it.

heading: 2 Track lifecycle
text: The software shall delete a track within 2 s of an operator deletion request.

heading: 3 Alarms
text: The software shall raise an alarm on the HMI within 500 ms when a track enters a restricted zone.

heading: 4 Event log
text: The software shall record every track deletion in the event log.

heading: 4 Event log
text: The software shall record every alarm in the event log.

heading: 3 Alarms
text: The software shall keep an alarm displayed on the HMI until the operator acknowledges it.

heading: 5 Capacity
text: The software shall manage at least 1000 simultaneous tracks.

heading: 5 Capacity
text: The software shall restore the tracks of the last 60 s after a restart.

heading: 6 HMI interface
text: The software shall send each new or updated track to the HMI in a TRACK message.

heading: 6 HMI interface
text: The software shall send each alarm to the HMI in an ALARM message.

heading: 6 HMI interface
text: The software shall send a HEARTBEAT message to the HMI every 1 s.

heading: 6 HMI interface
text: The software shall send a TRACK_DELETED message to the HMI when a track is deleted.
